sections.heading: Learning Point 1
sections.content: The Wonderful World of Science 1 Chapter As human beings, we have always been curious about our surroundings.
sections.source_evidence: The Wonderful World of Science 1 Chapter As human beings, we have always been curious about our surroundings.

sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: We start exploring our surroundings and asking questions right from our childhood.
sections.source_evidence: We start exploring our surroundings and asking questions right from our childhood.

sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: Did you enjoy discovering and exploring the world around you in the Preparatory Stage of school?
sections.source_evidence: Did you enjoy discovering and exploring the world around you in the Preparatory Stage of school?

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: As you enter the Middle Stage, we will continue this fascinating journey, trying to explore and understand the beautiful world we live in.
sections.source_evidence: As you enter the Middle Stage, we will continue this fascinating journey, trying to explore and understand the beautiful world we live in.

sections.heading: Learning Point 5
sections.content: And for that, we have a new subject, Science.
sections.source_evidence: And for that, we have a new subject, Science.

sections.heading: Learning Point 6
sections.content: Welcome to the wonderful world of Science!
sections.source_evidence: Welcome to the wonderful world of Science!

sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: Science is a way of thinking, observing and doing things to understand the world we live in and to uncover the secrets of the universe.
sections.source_evidence: Science is a way of thinking, observing and doing things to understand the world we live in and to uncover the secrets of the universe.

sections.heading: Learning Point 8
sections.content: Think of it as a big adventure—we ask questions, explore the world and try to understand how things work.
sections.source_evidence: Think of it as a big adventure—we ask questions, explore the world and try to understand how things work.

sections.heading: Learning Point 9
sections.content: For this, the most important thing is to have ‘Curiosity’, which is where the title of this book comes from.
sections.source_evidence: For this, the most important thing is to have ‘Curiosity’, which is where the title of this book comes from.

sections.heading: Learning Point 10
sections.content: Whether it is studying tiny grains of sand or massive mountains, a leaf of grass or a vast forest, there is always something new and exciting to discover.
sections.source_evidence: Whether it is studying tiny grains of sand or massive mountains, a leaf of grass or a vast forest, there is always something new and exciting to discover.

sections.heading: Learning Point 11
sections.content: Have you ever looked up at the night sky and wondered why the stars shine?
sections.source_evidence: Have you ever looked up at the night sky and wondered why the stars shine?

sections.heading: Learning Point 12
sections.content: Or watched a flower bloom and wondered how it knows when to open?
sections.source_evidence: Or watched a flower bloom and wondered how it knows when to open?

sections.heading: Learning Point 13
sections.content: These are just a few of the many mysteries that science helps us unravel.
sections.source_evidence: These are just a few of the many mysteries that science helps us unravel.

sections.heading: Learning Point 14
sections.content: The most wonderful thing about science is that it is everywhere.
sections.source_evidence: The most wonderful thing about science is that it is everywhere.

sections.heading: Learning Point 15
sections.content: From the depths of the ocean to the What is Science? ?
sections.source_evidence: From the depths of the ocean to the What is Science? ?

sections.heading: Learning Point 16
sections.content: Curiosity | Textbook of Science | Grade 6 2 Science is like a giant and unending jigsaw puzzle.
sections.source_evidence: Curiosity | Textbook of Science | Grade 6 2 Science is like a giant and unending jigsaw puzzle.

sections.heading: Learning Point 17
sections.content: Every new discovery we make adds another piece to that puzzle.
sections.source_evidence: Every new discovery we make adds another piece to that puzzle.

sections.heading: Learning Point 18
sections.content: And you know the best thing about this puzzle?
sections.source_evidence: And you know the best thing about this puzzle?

sections.heading: Learning Point 19
sections.content: There is no limit to what we can discover, since every new piece of knowledge leads to more questions and more things to find out.
sections.source_evidence: There is no limit to what we can discover, since every new piece of knowledge leads to more questions and more things to find out.

sections.heading: Learning Point 20
sections.content: Sometimes, we find that a piece of this puzzle has been put in the wrong place and needs to be moved.
